speaker: alice
text: Let's start on the water, because it is peak whale season along our coast right now. Thousands of humpbacks are cruising past on their way south, and this week a southern right whale calf was spotted having an absolute ball with its mum just off the coast.

speaker: charlie
text: Love that. There is nothing quite like standing on a headland with a coffee and watching a whale the size of a bus do a tail slap for no reason other than it feels like it. Pure joy, no charge.

speaker: alice
text: And it's not just the whales doing their bit for spring. Bushcare crews from Redlands right through to the Sunshine Coast hinterland have been turning out in big numbers for planting days, getting native seedlings in the ground while the weather is kind.
